component.name: Ledger
component.summary: COSMIC panel applet tracking AI usage and credits

description.p: Ledger is a native COSMIC panel applet that tracks your AI coding quota and prepaid credits across Claude Code, Codex, OpenRouter, OpenCode Go, and more directly from your panel. Add accounts once and Ledger fetches usage directly from provider APIs. No telemetry, no cloud sync, and no third-party accounts required.

ul.li: Claude Code usage tracking and extra usage meter
Fish Audio API credit balance tracking
Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, Grok, and OpenCode Go support
Clean, flat monochrome design inspired by Omarchy

description.p: Fixes from a code review: a new sign-in is never undone by older tokens from a failed save, older imported accounts stop refreshing automatically, imported tokens are used until they really expire, and more sign-in values are masked in debug output.
Accounts imported from the Grok CLI or OpenCode are no longer refreshed by Ledger, so it can't sign those tools out. Ledger uses each tool's current sign-in instead.
Security hardening: credentials never appear in debug output, the state and logs folders are private, only web links are opened, and token math can't overflow.
Provider logos are black and white by default, with a Color Provider Icons option. Refreshed tokens are never lost when a save fails, and sign-in is more robust against stray or stalled connections.
New app ID matching the GitHub account, with settings copied over automatically. Rewritten README with screenshots of every provider.

Adds Fish Audio API credit with an optional credits ring; with both rings on, click the ring to swap between ElevenLabs and Fish. New Switch Provider icon, reordered preferences, clearer ElevenLabs key errors, atomic credential writes, and OpenRouter settings now sync across processes.
Adds ElevenLabs: monthly credits with reset time, credits by API key, and an optional credits ring in every other provider's header.
Security fixes: Claude sign-in no longer exposes the PKCE verifier, and TLS dependencies are updated.
Renames the Debian package to cosmic-applet-ledger so it no longer clashes with the unrelated ledger accounting package.
Adds the OpenRouter provider and token usage charts, and redesigns the applet.

ul.li: New OpenRouter provider: daily and weekly spend, credit balance, and tokens by day and model
Tokens by day and by model for Claude and OpenRouter
Flat, minimalist redesign of the popup and settings
Grok's weekly limit is no longer shown twice

description.p: Initial release of Ledger for the COSMIC desktop.
